# dist/

The runnable bundle (`pack.mjs`), compiled from
`frontend/app/_views/projects/[id]/components-internal/plugins/reference/wayback-machine-pack.ts`
by `frontend/scripts/build-packs.mjs`.

Regenerate after editing the source:

```bash
cd frontend && node scripts/build-packs.mjs pluginpack-wayback-machine
```
